source_facts: ENTITYOS_HCU_JSPACE_INFERENCE_BINDING/v3 stores vector_control_packet_sha256 from TrainingTrace and input_sha256/input_size from InferenceReceipt, but has no invariant that derives or matches the executor input bytes to the Vector Control packet.

The integrated execution-store/inference/J-Space producer regression constructs ModelExecutionObservation.input_sha256 independently before it constructs the Global J-Space/GWT step and Vector Control packet used by TrainingTrace/v1.
Therefore current source invariants can satisfy the same JSpaceBinding/v3 chain under both a control-consumed world and a post-hoc-association world.
observation.hypothesis: The exact JSPACE_VECTOR_CONTROL_ABI/v1 packet or an admitted deterministic transform is consumed in the exact model-executor input bytes for the bound invocation.
observation.counterhypothesis: The model consumes unrelated input bytes and the Vector Control packet is created later and only associated through trace metadata.
